newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila arrests 21 Chinese fishermen off shoal.
newsitem.headline: Manila arrests 21 Chinese fishermen off shoal.

text.p: The Philippine Navy has arrested 21 Chinese fishermen off a disputed rock in the South China Sea which Manila and Beijing each claim, and China has protested the arrest, officials said on Tuesday.

A Navy spokesman said the 21 crew of the Chinese fishing boat were apprehended 11 km (seven miles) southeast of Scarborough Shoal on May 20 and were now being detained by the Coast Guard. Their vessel has been impounded, he said.
The Chinese embassy complained to the Foreign Ministry over the detentions and demanded the fishermen be released, a senior Filipino diplomat said.
The latest incident coincided with a current round of talks in Beijing between senior officials of the two countries aimed at defusing diplomatic tension.
Relations have become increasingly strained as both countries press their claims for the tiny islands and rocky outcrops in the South China Sea.
